text.tspan: Prototype: SMS/email and the GCash gateway are not connected.
Rent a vehicle without a driver from verified ZamMove owners. Pickup and return within Zamboanga City. Each vehicle has its own refundable
2 days · only vehicles free on every one of those days are shown as available.
Read the contract and sign it here before pickup, or sign the printed copy the owner brings. The vehicle can only be released once it is signed.
Pay the full ₱13,000.00 before pickup. The first ₱8,000.00 goes to the deposit. GCash is simulated in this prototype; a cashier verifies each payment.
Rental ₱5,400.00 + deposit ₱5,000.00 · Verified paid ₱0.00 · ₱5,000.00 waiting for cashier ·
Read the contract and sign it here before pickup, or sign the printed copy the owner brings. The vehicle can only be released once it is signed.
Pay the full ₱10,400.00 before pickup. The first ₱5,000.00 goes to the deposit. GCash is simulated in this prototype; a cashier verifies each payment.
This agreement is made between the
named below for the vehicle, period and price stated in sections
1 to 3, under the terms in section 4.
The Owner rents the vehicle described above to the Renter for self-drive use, without a driver, for
the rental period stated above. ZamMove only connects the parties, records payments and keeps this agreement.
The Renter pays the full rental fee and the refundable security deposit stated above through
ZamMove before pickup. The vehicle is released only after both are verified. The deposit is returned when the rental is
completed, less any amount kept under the Deposit claims clause.
Only the Renter may drive the vehicle, using the driver’s license stated above, which must stay valid
for the whole rental period. The Renter may not lend, sub-rent or hand over the vehicle to anyone else.
The vehicle stays within Zamboanga City unless the Owner agrees in writing. It may not be used for
hauling or transport for hire, racing, towing, driving under the influence, carrying more passengers than its seats, or any
For the safety of the vehicle, the Renter keeps location sharing switched on in ZamMove (My rentals
→ Share location) while driving during the rental period. The Owner and ZamMove staff may see the vehicle’s location only
from release until the vehicle is returned. Leaving Zamboanga City alerts the Owner.
At release and at return the Owner records the odometer, fuel level and condition in
ZamMove with photos of the front, back, both sides, odometer and fuel gauge, and the Renter confirms them or reports a
difference. The Renter returns the vehicle with the same fuel level, clean, with all keys, documents and accessories
The Renter reports any accident, damage, breakdown or loss to the Owner and through
ZamMove immediately, and to the police when required. The Renter pays for damage, loss and towing caused by the
Renter’s fault or by use not allowed in this agreement, after the Owner shows the repair cost.
Within 3 days after the return, the Owner may claim part or all of the deposit for damage, missing items,
fuel or late return, with photos and the amount. The Renter may accept or dispute the claim in ZamMove; a ZamMove
administrator decides disputes from the handover photos and evidence. The rest of the deposit is refunded when the rental
Fines, tolls, parking fees and violations incurred during the rental period are the Renter’s
The vehicle is returned at the return location on the end date. After a 2-hour grace period, every late day or
part of a day is charged at the daily rate unless the Owner agrees to an extension in ZamMove.
The Owner hands over a roadworthy, clean vehicle with a valid registration (OR/CR) and
compulsory third-party liability insurance (CTPL), and tells the Renter about any known defect before release.
The Renter may cancel in ZamMove before the vehicle is released. Payments already verified are handled
The parties’ personal data, license and ID photos and location are used only for this rental, safety and
legal claims, in line with the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173).
This agreement may be signed electronically in ZamMove or on a printed copy. Electronic signatures are
valid under the Electronic Commerce Act (RA 8792). Each party can read and print the signed agreement in ZamMove at

By signing, both parties confirm they have read and agree to sections 1 to 5.
The digital copy is kept in ZamMove: the renter finds it under Rent → My rentals, the owner under Vehicle Owner → Rentals. Any change to the terms
Your electronic signature has the same effect as signing on paper (Electronic Commerce Act, RA 8792).
